answer: A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in pigment, and sparrow reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 149 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ridge account. A 415 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
